schema.description: Response schema for a list of booking links

items.description: A reusable, shareable configuration for booking a service.

anyOf.description: This is an object representing a client.

created_at.description: Time at which the object was created.

email.description: The client's email address. This field will be `null` unless `include_sensitive` is `true`.

fields.description: Custom field values for this client as a map of field key to value. Sensitive field values will be `null` unless `include_sensitive` is `true`.

first_name.description: The client's first name. This field will be `null` unless `include_sensitive` is `true`.

last_name.description: The client's last name. This field will be `null` unless `include_sensitive` is `true`.

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs attached to this client. Maximum size is 16 KB.

phone.description: The client's phone number (E.164 format). This field will be `null` unless `include_sensitive` is `true`.

reference_id.description: External reference identifier for the client.

updated_at.description: Time at which the object was last updated.

anyOf.title: Client

client.description: The pre-selected client for the link, if any.

expires_at.description: When the link stops accepting new bookings. `null` means it never expires.

locked_fields.description: Fields that the public booker may not change on begotten booking intents.

max_uses.description: How many confirmed bookings the link may beget. `null` means unlimited.

name.description: An optional label for the link.

providers.description: The provider subset the link is restricted to. An empty array means the full service rotation applies.

items.description: A provider represents a staff member who can provide services to clients.

created_at.description: Time at which the object was created.

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs attached to this provider. Maximum size is 16 KB.

time_zone.description: The provider's preferred IANA time zone, used as the default when authoring schedules.

updated_at.description: Time at which the object was last updated.

items.title: Provider

service_id.description: The ID of the service the link belongs to.

status.description: The current state of the link. `paused` when deactivated, `expired` once past `expires_at`, `used_up` once `max_uses` is reached, otherwise `active`.

url.description: The fully-qualified URL at which the link can be booked. Resolves to the account's active custom domain when configured, otherwise the canonical app host.

uses_count.description: The number of confirmed bookings begotten through this link.

uses_remaining.description: The number of confirmed bookings still available. `null` when unlimited.

items.title: BookingLink

schema.title: BookingLinksResponse

items.description: A single validation error in JSON:API format.

example.detail: must be a valid email address
example.title: Invalid value

code.description: Machine-readable error code (e.g. slot_unavailable, no_available_provider, time_range_conflict)

items.title: JsonError
